card.name: Words before an expected outcome
card.fires_on: Small words such as "be" after "will" or "can", and "of" or "for" after "chance", in general web text. They sit just before a passive or outcome phrase such as "sent", "accepted" or "surviving".

modes.label: be after will/can
modes.description: The word "be" after a modal verb, leading into a passive verb like sent, accepted or registered.
modes.example: Once you are finished and click submit, your modifications will<< be>> sent to our editors for review.

modes.label: chance of/for
modes.description: "of" or "for" right after "chance", leading into a possible result.
modes.example: they metastasize because they have a greater chance<< of>> surviving," he says.

card.plain: It fires on small linking words that come right before a result or a passive action, like "will be sent" or "chance of surviving".
